verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript 3D rendering library. It has no concept of user automations that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation feature. Git cloning the library repo or following migration guides is library versioning, not automation management, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
